ext.name: PlainNote
ext.description: Create and manage PlainNote Markdown notes from your browser.

popup.subtitle: Quick save
popup.titleTooLong: Title must be at most 200 characters
popup.createdSuccess: Note created. Keep the edit link private.
popup.draftSaveFailed: Could not save draft — do not close yet
popup.saveNotShareHint: Saving is not public sharing — copy a public link only when you choose to.
popup.shareAfterCreate: Create a note first to share public links.
popup.editLinkSecurityWarning: The edit link contains private credentials — do not share it publicly.
popup.discardDraftBody: You have unsaved content. Keep the draft to restore next time, discard it and close, or cancel to keep editing.
popup.actionNewNoteDesc: Create a new plain-text or Markdown note
popup.actionClipDesc: Save the selected page content as a note
popup.actionSavePageDesc: Save the current page title and URL
popup.actionWorkbenchDesc: Manage notes, tags, and share history

workbench.brandSubtitle: Lightweight text · Fast capture · One-click share
workbench.selectOrCreate: Select a note, or press Ctrl+N to create

organization.noFoldersYet: No folders yet — create one to organize notes.
organization.noTagsYet: No tags yet — create one and optionally pick a color.
organization.confirmDeleteFolder: Delete folder "{name}"? Notes stay; they will just be unfiled.
organization.confirmDeleteTag: Delete tag "{name}"? It will be removed from notes that use it.

clip.pickHint: Click a note to append the clip, or create a new note.
clip.emptyNotes: No notes yet — create one first.

share.securityHint: Saving is not sharing. A public link is shared only when you explicitly copy or send it.
share.noServerToggle: There is no server public/private switch; anyone who knows the share id can read Note/Raw.
share.rawUrlHint: /raw/{id} — plain text for scripts and LLMs
share.editUrlWarning: This link can edit or delete the note. Confirm the recipient before copying.
share.editConfirmBody: The Edit URL contains a secret equivalent to an edit password. Do not post it publicly. History will record that you copied a private link without storing the Edit URL itself.
share.editNotInPublicTemplate: Never put the Edit URL in a public share template.
share.recordDeleted: Local share record deleted (remote note untouched)
share.noUrlToCopy: This record has no public URL to copy
share.historyNotAccess: History means you copied/opened a link — not that it was visited.

sidePanel.title: PlainNote
sidePanel.subtitle: Notes workspace
sidePanel.empty: No notes yet. Create your first note.
sidePanel.sharesHint: Only public link copies are stored; private edit URLs are never saved as readable links.
sidePanel.privateShareRecord: Private edit-link copy recorded (URL not stored)

options.title: PlainNote Settings
options.subtitle: Servers, defaults, data, and shortcuts
options.serverBaseUrlHint: Official default: https://plainshare-one.vercel.app. Add your own instance anytime.
options.serverManageHint: Manage PlainNote service URLs. Multiple services are supported; notes stay bound to the service used at creation.
options.urlRules: HTTP/HTTPS only; trailing slashes are stripped; usernames/passwords in the URL are rejected; HTTPS is preferred.
options.urlNoTrailingSlash: Do not include a trailing slash. HTTP/HTTPS only — usernames and passwords in the URL are rejected.
options.setDefaultHint: New notes will use this service
options.cannotUnsetDefault: Set another service as default before turning this off
options.connectionTestHint: Probes the URL currently entered to verify a reachable PlainNote instance.
options.testResultInvalidated: The service URL changed. Please test the connection again.
options.serviceUrlHelpBody: Enter the PlainNote deployment Origin only — no trailing slash and no /api path.
options.connectionTimeout: Connection timed out. Check the network or whether the service is reachable.
options.connectionNetworkError: Network error. Could not reach this service.
options.cannotDeleteOfficial: The official default service cannot be deleted
options.serviceInUse: Notes still bound to this service — cannot delete
options.deleteServiceBody: Removes this service profile. Remote notes are not deleted.
options.deleteServiceBlockedBody: {count} local notes still use this service. Reassign or remove them first.
options.deleteLastServiceBody: Keep at least one service configured. Add another service before deleting this one.
options.discardUnsavedBody: This service profile has unsaved edits. Switching will lose those changes.
options.emptyServicesDesc: Add at least one PlainNote service to get started.
options.emptyEditorHint: Select a service on the left, or click Add service.
options.usageGuideBullet1: Configure the official service and any number of self-hosted instances
options.usageGuideBullet2: Each note stores a serviceId at creation and never follows default changes
options.usageGuideBullet3: Changing the default only affects notes created later
options.usageGuideBullet4: Connection tests hit the real service; retest after changing the URL
options.serviceInfoBody: PlainNote is a lightweight text hosting API. The extension can use the official instance or your self-hosted server.
options.serviceInfoBullet2: Each note stays bound to its creation service
options.serviceInfoBullet3: Changing the default never rewrites existing notes
options.defaultsHint: Applied to Popup quick capture, side-panel New, and context-menu clips. Local folder/tags never leave this device.
options.defaultServiceHint: Only affects notes created later. Existing notes keep their serviceId.
options.editorPrefsHint: Changes apply immediately across Popup, side panel, and workbench.
options.autoSaveHint: Keeps unsaved text in IndexedDB. Network failures never clear a draft.
options.copyPublicLinkOnCreate: Copy public link after creating a note
options.copyPublicLinkOnCreateHint: Off by default. When enabled, copies the public Note URL after a successful create.
options.openEditorOnCreate: Open editor after creating a note
options.openEditorOnCreateHint: After Popup create succeeds, jump to that note’s editor.
options.markdownPreviewHint: You can still switch back to edit mode in the editor.
options.appearanceHint: Language and theme changes apply immediately.
options.themeHint: Choose light, dark, or follow the system.
options.shortcutsHint: These commands are registered with the browser Commands API. Change bindings on the browser extension shortcuts page — this screen only shows the live configuration.
options.dataHint: Export includes services, note index (with secrets), folders, tags, drafts, and share history. Remote notes are not deleted by local clears.
options.exportHint: Backup file contains edit secrets. Treat it like a password vault.
options.exportWarnBody: The backup contains Edit URL secrets for every indexed note. Anyone with this file can edit or delete those remote notes. Store it privately.
options.exportSecretsAck: I understand this file contains private edit secrets
options.importHint: Restores multi-service libraries. Notes whose service URL conflicts with an existing profile are skipped — secrets are never rebound to the wrong origin.
options.importWarnBody: Imported secrets stay bound to their service profiles. Replace mode clears local notes/org data first (remote notes stay on servers).

importPreview.includesSecrets: This backup includes private edit secrets

options.importSecretsAck: I understand secrets will be restored locally
options.importNeedAck: Please confirm you understand secrets will be restored
options.localDataHint: These actions only affect this browser. Use “Remove locally only” / “Delete remotely” on each note for precise control.
options.localVsRemoteWarning: This only clears extension local records. It never deletes remote PlainNote notes.
options.clearSharesBody: Deletes local share history. Public/private links themselves are unchanged.
options.clearNotesOrgBody: Deletes the local note index, folders, tags, and drafts. Remote notes remain on their servers (secrets in this browser will be lost).
options.clearAllBody: Wipes services (then re-seeds the official default), settings, notes, org data, drafts, and share history. Remote notes are not deleted.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: PlainNote Extension project info
about.description: Official PlainNote browser assistant for local notes, web clipping, Markdown editing, and multi-service setup.
about.licenseNote: See the repository LICENSE file for the authoritative license text.
about.changelog1: Settings center with sidebar navigation, services, and theme switching
about.changelog2: Editor preferences apply immediately across surfaces

editor.localDraftBanner: Local draft not synced to the server
editor.draftVsRemoteHint: Autosave writes a local draft only; tap “Update on server” to PATCH.
editor.editUrlWarning: Anyone with this link can edit or delete the note. Do not use it as a public share link.

contextMenu.openWorkbench: Open notes manager in a new tab

toast.copiedPrivateEdit: Private edit link copied — do not share publicly
toast.pickNoteInSidePanel: Pick a note in the side panel

dialog.deleteBody: Calls server DELETE to permanently remove the remote note and clear the local index. This cannot be undone.
dialog.deleteLocalBody: Deletes the local index and organization data only. The remote note remains reachable via its Edit URL.

errors.notFound: Note not found, or the link is invalid / deleted.

errors.serviceMismatch: Note does not belong to this service — cross-service action blocked
errors.hostPermissionDenied: Host access denied. Allow the server URL when prompted, then retry.
errors.clipboardFailed: Could not write to the clipboard. Check browser permissions and try again.
errors.noPage: Could not read the current page

serverUrl.PROTOCOL: Only HTTP or HTTPS is allowed
serverUrl.CREDENTIALS: Do not include username or password in the URL
